Controls.Title: Camera controls
Controls.Intro: Manage modules that control your camera. Higher priorities take precedence. These controls apply to this client unless marked world-wide.
Controls.PanicHint: Stop library camera movement, restore manual input, and block further control until re-enabled.
Controls.WorldDisabled: Camera control is disabled world-wide. A GM must re-enable it.
Controls.Inherit: Leave an override blank to use the default. Priority changes apply to the next claim.
